newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end mixed in thin trade.

text.p: * Value of shares traded at 2.1 billion pesos
Manila shares ended mixed on Monday amid thin volume as the market was in a wait-and-see mode, traders said.
"Investors are waiting and looking forward for projections on next year's economic growth," said Allan Araullo, vice-president at Regina Capital Development Corp.
The main index crawled up by 5.58 points, or 0.18 percent, to close at 3,095.74.
Losers trounced gainers 58 to 53 with 79 issues unchanged.
Araullo said nine-month GNP figures failed to substantially excite the market as investors were keen on projections for next year.
Lippo Securities assistant vice-president Rudsend Alpay said PLDT's poor performance in Wall Street on Friday contributed to the market's lacklustre performance.
Both traders said they expected the market to be on an uptrend before the month-end on positioning for next year and window dressing by fund managers.
